description: Docker-powered local Markdown notes server launcher; not a native Windows app.
notes: Requires Docker Desktop with Linux containers and a running Docker Engine. Scoop installs only this launcher; it does not install Docker.
Run many-notes or many-notes open to start the service at http://localhost:8180. Use many-notes stop, many-notes logs, or many-notes status to manage it.
The container uses the publisher's brufdev/many-notes:latest image. Data is kept in Docker named volumes; uninstalling this Scoop package removes the container but intentionally keeps those volumes.

script: try { & "$dir\many-notes.ps1" remove } catch { warn "Many Notes container removal could not be completed; remove it manually if Docker is unavailable." }
